Ludhiana Jail Official Suspended Over Alleged Bribe for Preferential Treatment

A Ludhiana jail official has been suspended following allegations of accepting payments for providing preferential treatment to undertrials in the Goods and Services Tax (GST) case. Reports indicate that sums of up to Rs 4 lakh were allegedly paid for better jail facilities. The suspension is a direct response to these accusations of corruption within the prison system.
